# Hotels With Bathtubs

> Hotels With Bathtubs (hotelswithbathtubs.com) is a curated travel directory helping couples and luxury travellers find verified hotels with private in-room bathtubs, jacuzzis, and hot tub suites worldwide.

## About

Hotels With Bathtubs is a travel discovery platform specialising in hotels that feature private in-room bathtubs, Jacuzzis, soaking tubs, and hot tub suites. Every listing is triple-checked for accuracy. The site covers 759+ verified stays across 104 cities in 19 countries.

## What We Offer

- Curated hotel listings with verified in-room bathtub amenities
- City and country destination guides for bathtub hotel stays
- Direct booking links via affiliate partners (MakeMyTrip, Agoda, Booking.com)
- Travel blog with guides for romantic stays and luxury bathtub experiences
- Smart search by destination, amenity type, and price range

## Countries Covered

Australia, Canada, France, Greece, India, Indonesia, Italy, Japan, Malaysia, Maldives, Netherlands, Singapore, Spain, Switzerland, Thailand, Turkey, UAE, UK, USA
